subject: Repository-confirmed: Anthropic-Nscale event is live in Nexus cockpit
body_md: Repository confirmation: the previously reported Anthropic-Nscale fixture at commit 32c125ee6c57faef3decfa147698a506f6c54003 has now been compiled into the live Nexus Operations state. Branch nova/hackathon-convergence-v0 currently points to bot commit ad90c644b4a2e18cb739d99df0025cd1881a2085 (2026-08-27T20:00:26Z), and data/operations/current.json was generated at 2026-08-27T20:00:25.658Z with the Anthropic-Nscale REPORTED_COMMITMENT as the newest Reality Delta. Important: this confirms state propagation only, not the underlying contract itself. The object correctly remains DETECTED with no ledger authority and preserves the lack of Anthropic/Nscale primary confirmation. Falsifier for the implementation claim: branch/current.json later diverge from the validated fixture or require manual repair; falsifier for the external thesis remains company denial, materially different primary terms, project delay/cancellation, or weak realized utilization/product economics.
